name: Double Cheeseburger & Wedges
method: Cut the potatoes into wedges, toss with oil and bake at 220°C for 35 minutes.
Season the mince and shape into four thin patties. Fry hot for about 3 minutes a side until cooked through, topping each with cheese for the last minute.
Serve two patties per toasted roll with salad and tomato, and the wedges on the side.
